judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the full-bleed background photo of the research section (img src /images/home/salt2.webp), with the heading 'Our research solves mysteries and transforms lives', a paragraph and three link buttons laid over it. It is not a link or control. Its alt, 'The Southern African Large Telescope under a starry sky with a visible Milky Way.', matches the crop and the screenshot: the SALT dome with its tall alignment tower against a starry night sky with the Milky Way, and SALT is a telescope UW–Madison takes part in, so the photo illustrates the section's research theme. Under 1.1.1 (G94/H37) an accurate short description of an informative photo gives an equivalent alternative. Someone could argue the image is decorative and should have a null alt (F38), but it shows a specific, recognisable research instrument rather than pure decoration, and an accurate alt is acceptable either way. So the element does not fail 1.1.1, and Rampa was right not to report it. captureDiffers: the snapshot gives the img a height of 0 (it was lazy-loaded when bounds were taken), but the screenshot shows the photo rendered, and the live HTML fetched on 2026-11-21 has the same img with the same alt in the same place, so nothing that touches this judgment differs.
